captions.detailed: A compact floor training pump featuring a low black rectangular base, a vertical black barrel, and a silver-colored piston rod that terminates in a T-handle. Integrated into the front of the base is a circular pressure gauge with a light grey rim, a white face, and a thin orange needle. The T-handle is equipped with a dark grey cylindrical folding grip sleeve on one side. The handle and rod slide vertically along the barrel axis, the gauge needle rotates on a central pivot, and the folding grip rotates continuously about the crossbar axis.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated compact floor pump in CadQuery with a low rectangular base, a vertical pump barrel, a circular gauge on the base with a rotating needle, and a T-shaped handle that slides vertically. Include a cylindrical grip sleeve on the crossbar that can rotate continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a box primitive and the vertical barrel using a cylinder. Model the pressure gauge with a cylinder for the housing and a thin box for the orange needle, then add a revolute joint for the needle. Build the sliding piston rod and T-handle assembly using cylinders, and attach it to the barrel with a prismatic joint. Finally, place a cylindrical grip sleeve on one side of the crossbar, connected via a continuous rotation joint.
